description: This Java class 'DeferredConnectionCheckHandler' manages concurrent connection checks, handling connection attempt states, timeouts, and completion of connection promises within the Eclipse Hono client implementation.

classes.name: DeferredConnectionCheckHandler
classes.description: Manages concurrent connection checks, including tracking ongoing attempts, handling timeouts, and completing connection promises.

classes.name: ExpiringConnectionCheckPromise
classes.description: Inner class representing a connection check promise with an expiration timer that fails the promise if not completed within a specified timeout.

methods.name: isConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Checks if a connection attempt is currently ongoing.

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Marks that a connection attempt is in progress.

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptFinished
methods.description: Marks the current connection attempt as finished and completes all accumulated connection check promises.

methods.name: addConnectionCheck
methods.description: Adds a connection check handler to be invoked after the current connection attempt finishes or times out.

methods.name: addToConnectionCheckPromises
methods.description: Atomically adds a promise to the list of ongoing connection check promises.

methods.name: removeFromConnectionCheckPromises
methods.description: Removes a promise from the list of ongoing connection check promises.
